body:
Found by the in-house qualification run of 2026-10-18 on the AX7101 (dev e9cbb676).

**Behaviour.** The dynamic audio mappings of STREAM_PORT_INPUT 0 and STREAM_PORT_OUTPUT 0 are cleared through ATDECC, then the board is cold power-cycled. Sampling rate, formats, presentation time offset, clock source and names persist. The cleared mapping lists come back as the 8 defaults.

**Required.** Milan v1.2 5.3.9.1 and 5.3.10.1: the channel mapping list "shall be saved in a non-volatile memory and restored after a power cycle". An empty list is a valid state to persist.

**Probable source (not verified on the device).**
- `sw/firmware/ctrl/aecp/aecp_nvm.c:96-104` stores a map as its rows padded with 0xFF, so an empty list is all 0xFF.
- `:60-66` reads 0xFF rows as unused.
- So an empty list cannot be told from an erased record, and the defaults are restored.

**Done when:**
- an empty mapping list, and a non-empty non-default one, both survive a power cycle;
- the record format separates "empty" from "erased";
- the saved-state tests cover both, with planted mutants;
- the change is checked on the board with a cold cycle.
title: Empty dynamic audio mapping lists are not restored after a power cycle
